title: DXF TABLE base-style-ID loss-prevention gate

research.finding: Autodesk's published TABLE DXF group-code schema contains no numeric base-style-ID group for columns, rows, or cells. Group 91 is the row count and repeated cell override flag; group 92 is the column count and repeated extended cell flags from AutoCAD 2007.
research.decision: Do not invent a DXF group-code mapping. Refuse nonzero DWG-origin base-style IDs until a documented, lossless conversion route exists.

scope: make dxfRW::writeTable refuse nonzero row and column style IDs that it previously ignored
retain the existing refusal for nonzero cell style IDs
verify refusal for each reference role in ASCII and Binary DXF output with destination preservation
generated_controls: valid rooted AC1021 TABLESTYLE graph with nonzero column style ID refuses ASCII and Binary DXF export
valid rooted AC1021 TABLESTYLE graph with nonzero row style ID refuses ASCII and Binary DXF export
valid rooted AC1021 TABLESTYLE graph with nonzero cell style ID refuses ASCII and Binary DXF export
existing destination sentinel remains unchanged for every refusal
